fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Kog'Maw''' enters a {{tip|zombie state}} for 4 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that increases up to {{as|50%|MS}} over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|{{pplevel|140 to 650}} true damage}}}} to nearby enemies.
fields.description2: While under this state, '''Kog'Maw''' becomes {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, but is also rendered unable to declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, cast {{tip|abilities}}, use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[active ability items|activate items]].

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
